clue.text: Seaside treat best to eat cold

clue.text: Cameron drinking ice tea mixed with a bit of elderberry for a spell of calm

taken as written

clue.text: Unfortunately sat in the middle of dad's food

clue.text: Chap in nets turned up and bowled over

clue.text: Attack on television
